SASBDB entry SASDJZ2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDJZ2/)

Publication: Activity and structure of EcoKMcrA.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gky731

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDJZ2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.

q cut (round 9, 2026-11-13): the script fits q <= 0.425 A^-1 and leaves out the noise tail: I/sigma about 1.6 up to 0.4 then noise; above the cut 34 of 157 points non-positive, mean I/sigma 0.9 (raised from 0.3 in round 9).
Every other entry without such a tail is fitted over its whole curve.
